decisions.reason: This optical connectivity service sits squarely in the firm's strategic move toward software-defined, high-bandwidth infrastructure and leverages owned network assets, so it remains worth keeping unless demand clearly disappoints.

The voice number ordering portal is a low-cost digital layer on top of the existing voice business that can improve customer handling and operating efficiency, so management would keep it while its support value persists.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony product with weak fit to the firm's growth direction, and after several years the option value of waiting is low enough that resources should be reallocated.

Direct voice network connection still complements the firm's enterprise connectivity base and may retain sticky business customers, so it is worth keeping although its longer-run strategic fit is less attractive than data-centric offers.
